usedFor: ThriveCart holds purchases and subscriptions, and Calendly creates a booking link through “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “Product Is Purchased” in ThriveCart, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A buyer can get a booking link after purchase, so onboarding calls are easy to schedule.

watchOut: “Upsell Purchased” and “Product Is Purchased” are separate triggers, so one buyer can get two links.
